```{python}
# Load data
database_url = os.getenv("DUCKDB_DB_URL")

dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_establishments").df()
near_dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_nearby_estabs_50mi").df()
air_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.air_quality").df()
bus_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.business_patterns").df()
code_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.naics_code_look_up").df()
gdp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.gdp").df()
inc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.personal_income").df()
pop_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.population").df()
perm_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.res_construction_permits").df()
emp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.unemployment").df()
county_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.us_counties_spatial").df()
```

## Create Table for Regressions

### Create final table

```{python}
bus_county_year_df = dbu.all_county_years(county_df, year_start=2007, year_end=2022)

pivoted_bus_df = mlu.pivot_naics(bus_df, code_df)

final_bus_df = bus_county_year_df[["county_id", "year"]].merge(pivoted_bus_df, on=["county_id", "year"], how="left")

final_bus_df = (
    final_bus_df
    .groupby("county_id", group_keys=False)
    .apply(dbu.impute_all_columns_for_county)
)

final_bus_df = dbu.spatial_then_yoy(final_bus_df, county_df)
```

```{python}
# Create county_year dataframe for merging below
county_year_df = dbu.all_county_years(county_df, year_start=2007, year_end=2022)

county_year_df = county_year_df[["county_id", "year", "land_area_sqmi", "water_area_sqmi"]]

county_year_df["total_area_sqmi"] = county_year_df["land_area_sqmi"] + county_year_df["water_area_sqmi"]
```

```{python}
near_dc_df["nearby_estabs_50mi_landadj"] = near_dc_df["nearby_estabs_50mi_landadj"].round()
```

```{python}
final_df = mlu.combine_dfs(county_year_df, [air_df, final_bus_df, gdp_df, inc_df, pop_df, perm_df, emp_df, dc_df, near_dc_df])
```

### Clean up final table

```{python}
# Make applicable columns per-capita
bus_cols = ["tot_employee_count", "annual_payroll", "tot_establishment_count"]

cols = [c for c in final_df.columns if any(l in c for l in bus_cols)]

per_capita_cols = [
    "real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands",
    "real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars",
    "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "all_permits",
    "all_permits_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "single_family_permits",
    "single_family_permits_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "all_multifamily_permits",
    "all_multifamily_permits_spatial_weighted_avg_5"
] + cols

final_df = mlu.make_per_capita(final_df, per_capita_cols)

final_df["single_family_permits_per_1000"] = (
    final_df["single_family_permits_per_capita"] * 1000
)

final_df["all_multifamily_permits_per_1000"] = (
    final_df["all_multifamily_permits_per_capita"] * 1000
)
```

```{python}
# Per-capita data centers (don't drop original though)
final_df["datacenters_per_capita"] = final_df["estabs"] / final_df["population"]
final_df["datacenters_spatial_per_capita"] = final_df["estabs_spatial_weighted_avg_5"] / final_df["population"]
```

```{python}
# Rename for clarity
final_df = final_df.rename(columns = {
    "annual_payroll_per_capita": "annual_payroll_thousands_per_capita", 
    "estabs": "datacenters",
    "estabs_per_100_sqmi": "datacenters_per_100_sqmi",
    "nearby_estabs_50mi_landadj": "nearby_datacenters_50mi",
    "nearby_estabs_50mi_per_100_sqmi": "nearby_datacenters_50mi_per_100_sqmi",
    "estabs_spatial_weighted_avg_5": "datacenters_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "unemployment_rate": "unemployment_rate_pct"
    })

# Drop temporal columns as the regression model should be able to handle this without needing extra columns
final_df = final_df.drop(columns = final_df.columns[final_df.columns.str.contains("yoy", case=False)])

final_df = final_df.sort_values(["county_id", "year"]).reset_index(drop=True)
```

```{python}
# Define potential useful groupings
reg_dc_cols = [
    "datacenters",
    "nearby_datacenters_50mi"
] # Always include both of these (lagged 2 year), unless size_cols are used

reg_dc_density_cols = [
    "datacenters_per_100_sqmi",
    "nearby_datacenters_50mi_per_100_sqmi"
] # Only include these if size_cols are not used (lagged 2 year), and if more significant than dc_col. If one is used, always use the other

reg_size_cols = [
    "land_area_sqmi_log",
    "total_area_sqmi_log"
] # Only include the more significant one

reg_sector_cols = [
    "tot_employee_count_industrial_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_information_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_professional_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_public_services_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_primary_industries_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_trade_transport_per_capita_log1p"
] # Can include any number of these, always exclude information unless explicitly specified

reg_pop_col = [
    "population_log"
] # Only include if significant

reg_econ_cols = [
    "real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_per_capita_log",
    "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log",
    "unemployment_rate_pct"
] # Can include any number of these

reg_env_cols = [
    "pm25_mean_daily_avg",
    "pm25_mean_daily_avg_spatial_weighted_avg_5"
] # Only include one of these

reg_permit_cols = [
    "single_family_permits_per_1000_log1p",
    "all_multifamily_permits_per_1000_log1p"
] # Only include one of these

reg_key_cols = [
    "county_id",
    "year"
] # Don't ever include except as fixed effect
```

## Linear Regressions


```{python}
outcomes = [
    "unemployment_rate_pct",
    "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log",
    "single_family_permits_per_1000_log1p",
    "all_multifamily_permits_per_1000_log1p",
    "real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_per_capita_log",
    "pm25_mean_daily_avg",
    "pm25_mean_daily_avg_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "tot_employee_count_industrial_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_information_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_professional_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_public_services_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_primary_industries_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_trade_transport_per_capita_log1p",
    "population_log"
]

for y_col in outcomes:
    print("\n" + "=" * 100)
    print(f"RUNNING REGRESSION ON: {y_col}")
    print("=" * 100)

    exclude_from_lasso = ["year_num"] + reg_dc_cols + reg_size_cols
    
    if y_col in reg_env_cols:
        # Don't let neighboring environmental factors predict county environmental factors (and vice versa)
        exclude_from_lasso.extend(reg_env_cols)

    if y_col in reg_permit_cols:
        # Too closely related
        exclude_from_lasso.extend(reg_permit_cols)

    if y_col in reg_pop_col: 
        # Don't let residential permits predict population (population is upstream cause)
        exclude_from_lasso.extend(reg_permit_cols)
        # Don't let per-capita variables predict population (they're already derived from pop)
        exclude_from_lasso.extend(reg_sector_cols + ["real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_per_capita_log","personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log"])

    if y_col in ["real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_per_capita_log", "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log"]:
        # Avoid letting core eceonomic outcomes predict each other
        exclude_from_lasso.extend(["real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_per_capita_log", "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log"])

    mlu.run_lasso_plus_regression(
        df=regression_df,
        y_col=y_col,
        reg_dc_cols=None,
        reg_dc_density_cols=reg_dc_density_cols,
        reg_size_cols=None,
        reg_sector_cols=reg_sector_cols,
        reg_pop_col=reg_pop_col,
        reg_econ_cols=reg_econ_cols,
        reg_env_cols=reg_env_cols,
        reg_permit_cols=reg_permit_cols,
        exclude_from_lasso=exclude_from_lasso,
        dc_lag=2,
        county_fe=True,
        year_fe=True,
        include_information=False
    )
```
